details: Malicious package. Uses the same scope, raw-IP collector and callback path as @kui-react/button (MAL-2026-1625). When the package is loaded, its index.js (826 bytes, sha256 e14e45143ec130b2fb3ca3c21041f917ae340658224ff289df2f426f9cb7e44e) makes an HTTP request to http://159.223.17.233:8000/nvidia_callback/. Observed in a sandboxed install, which connected to 159.223.17.233. The package has since been removed from the npm registry; every version is listed as affected because the version list can no longer be recovered.
